text:
alex: Quick follow-up to the admission/throttle RFC: propose graded throttles (soft/medium/hard) and a soft-failover path that routes to cheaper model variants instead of immediate rejects.

maya: Good direction. Can you list the signals that bump a tenant between grades? 

alex: Draft list: 1) sustained token rate > tenant_commit * 1.5 for >2m; 2) model error spike (5xx or streaming terminations); 3) rapid ephemeral key creation or client IP churn. We'll weight signals and produce a single score->grade mapping.

sam: How do we avoid flapping? Last burst detector caused oscillation.

alex: Add hysteresis + min hold time per transition (2m) and exponential backoff on demotion. Also require threshold held across a rolling window.

leila: Interface boundary question: should admission emit numeric abuse_score or explicit grade+reason? I want grade+reason for observability.

jin: Grade+reason is clearer but larger contract. Suggest abuse_score (0..100) + optional tags and a compact grade field.

maya: Also remember tiers: Dedicated vs free should have different thresholds. Policy store must include tenant_tier and fallback mappings.

alex: Policy store will hold per-tenant thresholds and fallback model map (e.g., modelA -> modelA-quant). Defaults in config.

sam: Operational: how does router learn about fallback without coupling to model internals?

alex: Admission can return an opaque route_hint like "fallback:v2-quant|reason=rate". Router resolves hint->endpoint using local cache.

leila: Make hint opaque so routers don't need model schema. Also include TTL on hint.

jin: What if hint is stale? Router should fallback to admission query or a global default.

alex: We'll add TTL=30s on route_hint and metric for hint_miss. Also router should refresh mapping asynchronously.

maya: Abuse responses: want to avoid product UX regressions. Prefer staged response: soft downgrade -> medium (leaky bucket) -> hard 429 with header. Captchas are product-level so defer.

sam: Agreed. Implement leaky bucket for medium grade and clear error headers on hard reject.

leila: SDKs need consistent headers to adapt. Propose header: `X-Redwood-Throttle: grade=medium;hint=fallback:v2-quant;reason=rate`.

jin: Also add structured events for transitions: prev_grade/new_grade+reason for alerts.

alex: Big refactor: extract scoring into its own scalable microservice (score-service) that admission queries. Admission then merges score+policy to produce grade/route_hint.

leila: Action items: maya prototype policy schema, jin write route_hint API contract, sam run load tests for graded thresholds, leila draft SDK header handling. Alex will update RFC with sequence diagram and event schema.

deploy-bot: alex requested RFC update. Link: https://r.infra/rfc/graded-throttles (draft)

maya: Starting schema PR today. Ping me if you have churny IP harness.

sam: I'll simulate tenant bursts tomorrow AM and post results.

leila: Telemetry note: emit transition events and histogram of abuse_score so SRE can alert on rapid demotions and correlate with infra.

alex: Logging event format in RFC. Thanks all :thumbsup:
